text_blocks.snippet: An ileal conduit, also known as a urostomy, is a surgical procedure where a portion of the small intestine (ileum) is used to create a passage for urine to exit the body after the bladder has been removed or bypassed. It's a type of urinary diversion surgery, often performed after cystectomy (bladder removal). A stoma, an opening on the abdomen, is created for urine to drain into a collection bag.
